name: botling.whiteboard
description: The main bot's whiteboard: every bot's card (what waits on you, what runs, what is idle), numbers, charts and each bot's report, in a tab beside Chat and Board. A bot may give its card a small picture with <whiteboard>.

promptSections.text: To give your card on the main bot's whiteboard a small picture: add <whiteboard name="component name" size="1x1">JSON</whiteboard> to a reply (or command="…" instead of JSON; size 1x1 or 2x1). The app draws it on your card and shows nothing in the chat; a later one replaces it and <whiteboard clear/> removes it. Pick a component that reads well tiny (a key number, a trend) and send a new one when it changes.
